परीक्षार्थियों के लिए निर्देश / Instructions for the candidates :
1. परीक्षार्थी OMR उत्तर-पत्रक पर अपना प्रश्न पुस्तिका क्रमांक (10 अंकों का) अवश्य लिखें।
2. परीक्षार्थी यथासंभव अपने शब्दों में ही उत्तर दें।
3. दाहिनी ओर हाशिये पर दिये हुए अंक पूर्णांक निर्दिष्ट करते हैं।
4. प्रश्नों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ने के लिए परीक्षार्थियों को 15 मिनट का अतिरिक्त समय दिया गया है।
5. यह प्रश्न पुस्तिका दो खण्डों में है – खंड-अ और खंड-ब
6. खंड-अ में 80 वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्न हैं। इनमें से किन्हीं 40 प्रश्नों का ही उत्तर देना है। प्रत्येक प्रश्न के लिए 1 अंक निर्धारित है। यदि कोई परिक्षार्थी 40 प्रश्नों से अधिक का उत्तर देता है, तो प्रथम 40 [continues next page]

Question Booklet Serial No. :
SECONDARY SCHOOL EXAMINATION – 2026
(ANNUAL)
Subject Code : 112
MODEL QUESTION PAPER
SCIENCE (Compulsory)
Question Booklet Set Code : [blank box]
Total Questions : 100 + 30 + 8 = 138
Total Printed Pages : 30
[Time : 2 Hours 45 Minutes]
[Full Marks : 80]
Instructions for the candidates :
1. Candidates must enter his/her Question Booklet Serial No. (10 Digits) in the OMR Answer Sheet.
2. Candidates are required to give their answers in their own words as far as practicable.
3. Figures in the right hand margin indicate full marks.
4. An extra time of 15 minutes has been allotted for the candidates to read the questions carefully.
5. This Question booklet is divided into two sections-SECTION-A and SECTION-B
6. In SECTION-A, there are 80 objective type questions, out of which any 40 questions are to be answered. Each question carries one mark. If a candidate answers more than 40 questions, then answer of first 40 [continues next page]

notes: Cover page title is 'SECONDARY SCHOOL EXAMINATION – 2026 ... MODEL QUESTION PAPER' — this is Bihar Board's official model/specimen paper for the 2026 exam, NOT a real attempted past exam paper. User confirmed (2026-08-05): include as-is, but flag clearly that this is a model paper, not a genuine PYQ attempt (no student pen-marks possible — never actually administered).

Cover states 'कुल प्रश्न : 100 + 30 + 8 = 138' (Total Questions: 100+30+8=138) — this does NOT match the actual instruction breakdown on page 2/3 (Section-A 80 objective + Section-B 24 short + 6 long = 110). Printed as-is per Stage B rule (transcribe what's shown, don't correct); Stage C+ should use the instruction-text numbers (80/24/6), not this cover total, matching every other year's paper.
Question Booklet Set Code box is blank/empty on this PDF (no code printed inside it).
Page footer: 'Page 1 of 30' — printed page count matches PDF page count exactly (30 = 30), no front-page offset like 2024-a/2025 had.
